description: This is a Java JUnit test case class for testing the snapshotting functionality of the PolicyPersistenceActor within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains tests verifying correct snapshot creation, retrieval, re-creation after deletion, and handling of snapshot intervals, applied to policy persistence actor state management.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorSnapshottingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying snapshotting behavior of PolicyPersistenceActor in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up event adapters and command-to-event mappings.

methods.name: convertJournalEntryToEvent
methods.description: Converts a journal BSON document entry into an Event object with the assigned sequence number.

methods.name: convertDomainIdToPersistenceId
methods.description: Converts a PolicyId to a persistence ID string used internally.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToPolicy
methods.description: Converts a BSON snapshot data into a Policy object, verifying revision alignment.

methods.name: deletedPolicyIsSnapshotWithCorrectDataAndCanBeRecreated
methods.description: Test verifying correct snapshot for deleted policies and their re-creation after actor restart.

methods.name: policyInArbitraryStateIsSnapshotCorrectly
methods.description: Test ensuring policies in arbitrary states are snapshot correctly with accurate revision and data.

methods.name: snapshotIsCreatedAfterSnapshotIntervalHasPassed
methods.description: Test verifying snapshots are created automatically after the interval passes with changes.

methods.name: snapshotsAreNotCreatedTwiceIfSnapshotHasBeenAlreadyBeenCreatedDueToThresholdAndSnapshotIntervalHasPassed
methods.description: Test ensuring no duplicate snapshots are generated when threshold and interval conditions are met.

methods.name: assertSnapshotsEmpty
methods.description: Utility to assert that no snapshots exist for a policy ID.

methods.name: assertJournal
methods.description: Utility to assert journal contains expected events with retries.

methods.name: retryOnAssertionError
methods.description: Runs a runnable with retries upon assertion failures, within specified timeout.

methods.name: assertPolicyInJournal
methods.description: Checks that actual and expected policies match within journal events.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorFor
methods.description: Creates a persistence actor instance for a given policy ID.

methods.name: toEvent
methods.description: Convert a command into the corresponding domain event with a specified revision.

methods.name: assertSnapshots
methods.description: Verifies snapshot list matches expected snapshot policies.

methods.name: assertPolicyInSnapshot
methods.description: Asserts a snapshot policy matches expected policy data and revision.

methods.name: assertPolicyInResponse
methods.description: Asserts the policy object in response matches expected data and revision.

methods.name: assertEqualJson
methods.description: Checks JSON equality between two policy objects.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Pauses execution for a given number of seconds.
